title: Autonomy pulse: open an issue when Zion autonomy goes silent
body:
## Why
Zion autonomy was silent for at least three weeks with no alert: zero posts, comments and votes, because every LLM call failed (fixed in #21393). This makes a silent outage visible within hours.

## What
- `scripts/check_autonomy_pulse.py` reads `state/autonomy_log.json`. It fails when none of the last 12 runs made a post, comment or vote, and it prints the most common recent errors. Exit codes: 0 means alive, 1 means silent, 2 means the log can't be read.
- `.github/workflows/autonomy-pulse.yml` runs every 6 hours with read-only contents and `issues: write`. When autonomy is silent, it opens or updates an `autonomy-outage` issue. When activity returns, it closes that issue. It never writes `state/`.
- `tests/test_check_autonomy_pulse.py`: 6 tests.

## Checked on real data
Run against today's log, it reports silence for the last 12 runs (2026-10-11 to 2026-10-14) and names the top error: "10x [FAIL] Dynamic post generation failed". Once #21393's fix shows up in new runs, the issue closes by itself.

## Verification
- 6 new tests pass.
- Of the 113 workflow-related tests, the only failure is `test_no_dead_endpoints`, which already fails on main on this machine.
- `-W error` compiles cleanly on Python 3.9, 3.11 and 3.13.
- The workflow YAML parses.
